card.name: Words leading into a comparison or example
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "as", "of" or "how" that come just before a comparison, an analogy or an example. It also fires on verbs like "predict" or "trying" that open the described action. The setting is general web prose.

modes.label: Second "as" in comparisons
modes.description: The word "as" that finishes an "as ... as" comparison, just before the thing compared to.
modes.example: relying on the heartbeat to indicate gender is about as reliable<< as>> the a coin toss.

modes.label: Link word before an example
modes.description: "of" or "how" that introduces a described activity or illustration.
modes.example: she may be developing a mathematical model<< of>> a biological or chemical system

modes.label: Verb after a comparison
modes.description: A verb that begins the action being compared or described.
modes.example: accessing your website may be as frustrating as<< trying>> to read a Latin version of War and

card.writes: It promotes words that begin descriptive phrases, such as "used for", "wearing", "chasing" and "whether", but the effect is weak.
card.plain: It marks the little word just before a comparison or illustration is spelled out.
